revision_atomicity.claim: every observation in this run was collected at one exact committed revision
revision_atomicity.how: the working tree was clean at 1e681b9b before the first collector started; both columns and the verdict were given that same revision explicitly, and verify_runtime_fault_matrix refuses any observation whose source_revision differs
revision_atomicity.evidence: the verdict carries zero fault.stale-revision and zero fault.matrix-stale-revision blockers

key_material.what_these_signatures_mean: a development-key signature proves only that this machine's collector output was not altered between collection and verification. It is NOT operator authority, NOT an owner approval, and NOT a production trust anchor.
key_material.what_they_do_not_mean: no row of this run may be cited as gate-closing evidence. Closing Gate 0 requires the same run under production key custody, which this lane neither holds nor can mint.
key_material.issuer_separation: each issuer is authorized for exactly one authority, so a fixture signature over a Linux-host row (or the reverse) is refused rather than counted
key_material.key_generation: both secrets were freshly generated for this run via python secrets.token_hex(32), held only in the issuing process environment, and never written to disk or committed

live-runtime.note: no collector column exists for this authority yet, so these rows have no observation at all

fault.blocked.why: these four executors need a container runtime inside the already containerized executor, i.e. Docker-in-Docker, which this host does not provide. The driver records honest ignorance rather than a pass.

fault.missing.why: the live-runtime authority has no collector column at this revision. Genuinely open, deliberately not papered over.

absent_by_measurement.note: every required row that could be observed was observed within the reconciliation deadline, matched its expected terminal outcome, and carried a trusted attestation over its exact record digest

runtime_conformance.binding_gap_measured: the registered report CLIs (scripts/report_gate0_v3.py and python -m daedalus.gates) expose no receipt-dir flag and the binding performs no filesystem discovery, so the persisted bundle binds only when runtime_conformance_receipt_dir is passed to the builder API; gate-report-v3-cli.json retains the unbound CLI measurement, gate-report-v3.json is the bound builder-API run

reproduction.note: the two signing secrets are development key material held only by the operator who ran this. Re-verification requires the same two environment variables; the artifacts themselves are content-addressed and can be re-collected without them. The combiner is the module daedalus.runtimes.whole_fault_matrix.verify_whole_runtime_fault_matrix; this run directory deliberately carries no script copy, because the registry names a dated script copy as a fresh unregistered-entrypoint blocker. The registered thin CLI delegate over that module is retained at runs/gate0-matrix-2026-08-17/verify_whole_matrix.py and takes every path as a flag.
